translation: Alas! All the affairs of the world are like this; is it only medicine? I then asked Master Cheng: With your Way, you treat the people of the world. In our own generation you are already too busy to spare time, and after your death the book will not exhaust the words, and the words will not exhaust the meaning; I fear it will not be transmitted. Why not obtain a person and transmit it to him, rather than a book? Master Cheng said: A teacher seeking a disciple is more eager than a disciple seeking a teacher. If there is a person who comes to learn, I wish to exhaust what I have learned. But unlike the learners of today, who have never sought learning but only seek to practice, this Way cannot be obtained without ten years of bitter effort.
